articles.title: Bell Commissioners to Name Temporary Replacement for JP Barfield
articles.excerpt: David Barfield served as Bell County Justice of the Peace for Precinct 3, Place 1, based in Temple (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Two Bell County Jps Not Performing Marriages
articles.excerpt: Ivey among those who had not yet said whether they would (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Bell County JP Sheriff Constable Seats Up in May Election
articles.excerpt: Ahead of the 2020 elections the Herald listed "Precinct 3, Place 1, Justice of the Peace David Barfield" among the unopposed Bell County incumbents (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Social Distanced Swearing in Bell County Officials Take Office Differently Due to Covid
articles.excerpt: At the swearing-in of officials elected in November 2020, the Herald reported that Barfield had told county officials he could not serve because of a medical condition and was sworn in over the phone (Killeen Daily Herald).
